items.title: US sailors arrive in Thailand's Pattaya after record 250 days at sea
items.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln is docking close to Pattaya, known for its neon-lit nightlife, and for sex tourism.

items.title: Why US troops have a history in this raucous Thai city
items.description: The BBC's Jonathan Head looks at the historical echoes of US troops arriving in Pattaya, a beach resort famous for its racy bars.

items.title: Nepal-Tibet flood response turns to relief and recovery
items.description: More than 1,000 people have died and thousands are missing, as rescue efforts continue and aid is airlifted to villages.

items.title: BBC travels inside occupied Lebanon as officials say Israel expanding positions
items.description: A BBC team joined a humanitarian mission of the UN peacekeeping force, which says Israeli troops are fortifying positions and continuing demolitions.

items.title: Zelensky says airlines should avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations
items.description: Chinese and Gulf state airlines are among those still using Russian airspace. Meanwhile, Russia says it will intensify its own attacks on Ukraine.

items.title: Bus crash on Egypt's Red Sea coast kills 22
items.description: Reports say Jordanian nationals are among those killed in the accident in the South Sinai governorate.

items.title: More than 900 killed in Gaza this year despite ceasefire, Hamas-run health ministry says
items.description: The ministry says the total number of people killed in the Strip since 10 October is now more than 1,300, including 301 children.

items.title: Madagascar ex-Senate chief sentenced  to hard labour over deadly Gen Z protest crackdown
items.description: At least 22 people were killed and more than 100 injured during last year's unrest, according to the UN.

items.title: Charlie Kirk murder suspect pleads not guilty as judge clears way for death penalty trial
items.description: The  23-year-old is charged with aggravated murder, a capital offence in Utah, and six other counts.

items.title: South Korea jails care home head for sexually assaulting disabled residents
items.description: The man, surnamed Kim, was handed a 15-year prison term for abusing three residents at the facility near Seoul.

items.title: Tiger Woods to change plea after crash arrest
items.description: The golfer will be in court on Wednesday for a hearing to change his plea after being charged with driving under the influence.

items.title: Guinea-Bissau referendum approves new constitution that expands president's powers
items.description: The sweeping reforms come in the wake of last year's coup and ahead of a proposed return to civilian rule.
